title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED ELEVEN HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-EIGHT BY FURTHER EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT, WITHOUT PENALTY, OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF OCCIDENTAL NEGROS FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR UNTIL JANUARY THIRTY-FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED ELEVEN HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-EIGHT BY FURTHER EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT, WITHOUT PENALTY, OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF OCCIDENTAL NEGROS FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR UNTIL JANUARY THIRTY-FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FIVE.
title.vi: Luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 1178, gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế đất năm 1904 tại tỉnh Negros Occidental không bị phạt đến ngày 31 tháng 1 năm 1905
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขกฎหมายฉบับที่ 1178 ขยายกำหนดชำระภาษีที่ดินปี 1904 ในจังหวัด Negros Occidental โดยไม่เสียค่าปรับถึงวันที่ 31 มกราคม 1905
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 1178, memperpanjang batas pembayaran pajak tanah tahun 1904 di Provinsi Negros Occidental tanpa denda hingga 31 Januari 1905
title.ms: Akta meminda Akta No. 1178, melanjutkan tempoh pembayaran cukai tanah tahun 1904 di Wilayah Negros Occidental tanpa penalti hingga 31 Januari 1905

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Eleven hundred and seventy-eight is hereby amended to read as
"Section 1. The period for the payment, without penalty, of the land tax for the year nineteen hundred and
four in the Province of Occidental Negros is hereby extended to January thirty-first, nineteen hundred and

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 7, 1904.
